text:
maya-partnerships: FYI got an update from Nitro on the H100 shipment for EU racks. Theyjust pushed the ETA 3 weeks due to thermal test rework. This affects a set of Dedicated reservations and a co-sell SKU launch next month.
alex-nitro: Confirmed. H100 batch 7 failed thermal sampling; were redoing the run. Earliest ship is now ~2026-05-12. Sorry for the scramble.
toni-sales: Oof. We have three mid-May Dedicated rollouts (eu-west-1) tied to the marketplace SKUs. Two are paid pilots that expect on-prem-like performance.
reza-legal: Any force majeure language we can lean on? Also need to know which customer contracts have strict delivery SLAs.
mike-ops: On list: acct-lodestar (pilot), acct-aurora (reserved enterprise), acct-pegasus (marketplace co-sell). Pegasus is the one linked to marketplace SKU sku-rw-pega-eu.
tess-eng: Performance-wise, we can temporarily map those Dedicated routes to cloud-marketplace instances running H100-equivalent VMs in eu-west-3 but cost will spike and KV caches won't migrate. Latency will be slightly higher.
maya-partnerships: @marketplace-bot can you show if sku-rw-pega-eu is active and capacity available?
marketplace-bot: SKU sku-rw-pega-eu - status: active - available_quota: 12 - regions: eu-west-3, eu-west-1 (limited) - note: procurement lead ~5 days for reserved VMs.
toni-sales: 12 looks promising but lead time for reserved VMs is 5 days, which still misses some customer rollouts.
alex-nitro: We can prioritize 2 racks to Pegasus if you sign a swap acknowledgement and cover expedite fees (8% of hardware cost).
re vs-legal: We need an official amendment template for swap / expedite fees + credit to standard tenants. I can draft.
tess-eng: Technical caveat: if we failover to marketplace VMs, we must instrument prefix warming for token caches and increase batch windows. Expect 15-35% latency delta depending on model.
mike-ops: Ops suggestion: create a Temp Allocation policy that 1) routes 60% traffic to marketplace VMs, 40% stays queued for Dedicated until racks arrive, 2) flag customers who opt-in for expedited marketplace fallback. Example policy snippet: 
```
allocation_policy:
  - id: temp-h100-fallback-2026-05
    region: eu-west-1
    fallback_priority:
      - marketplace_eu_w3: 60%
      - dedicated_pending: 40%
    opt_in_tag: marketplace_fallback
```

maya-partnerships: Good. Toni, can you run customer opt-in calls for Pegasus and Lodestar? Offer credits + discounted usage for marketplace fallback.
toni-sales: On it. I'll propose 20% service credit + waived early-termination for pilots.
re za-legal: Drafting amendment now. Will include option language and indemnity tweak for partner-supplied hardware delays. Need delivery dates from Nitro in writing.
alex-nitro: Sending formal delay notice in 30m with revised ETA and QC report.
tess-eng: Also recommend we adjust Marketplace SKU description to mention soft performance variance and add a migration guide so customers know what to expect.
maya-partnerships: Marketplace-bot, can you add a temporary banner to the SKU page saying "limited expedited availability; performance may vary during fallback"?
marketplace-bot: Banner added to sku-rw-pega-eu: "Temporary expedited fulfillment available. Performance may vary during fallback. Contact partnerships for details."
mike-ops: Opening incident INC-2026-0502 to track deliveries + customer communications.
marketplace-bot: Incident INC-2026-0502 created by mike-ops priority: P2 title: Partner H100 delay impacting marketplace SKUs.
maya-partnerships: Action items: @alex-nitro written ETA + QC report by EOD, @toni-sales customer opt-in list by EOD, @reza-legal amendment draft by EOD, @tess-eng migration guide + perf delta table by noon tomorrow, @mike-ops allocation policy + incident ticket owner. Well sync in partnerships standup tomorrow. :eyes:
